title: GOAL Phase D: token diet — Planner as a function of decision points, one review per task, scouts on a budget, context-size restarts, cost per task visible
spec: User decision 2026-09-18 19:10. Measured that day: the Planner session used about 11.2M tokens by the pool metric (411 turns, avg context 257k, 112 monitor notifications each a full turn) against about 2.5M for all 25 worker runs (16.78 USD: scouts 4.59, execute 4.56, opus reviews 4.61, sonnet reviews 1.43, spec reviews 1.59). Fallback tasks got two reviews. Levers in order: D3 Planner invoked by the daemon only at decision points with a fresh context; D1 one review per task by the other model, spec review from complexity 6 on sonnet; D2 scouts on haiku where enumeration suffices, 12 turns, 800-token results, none for goals under complexity 5; D4 restart at 150k context via handover and one notification per wait; D5 cost per task and per goal in the scorecard. Depends on Phase C pieces: C-O3 v3 (T-0103) and C-O7b (T-0108) for D3, C-O6b (T-0102) for daemon.py edits.
acceptance: D1-D5 merged into goal/<this id> with green gate and reviews per the new policy
A goal run after D3 shows Planner token use per invocation in the scorecard well below the interactive session baseline recorded in plan.md
PR goal/<this id> to main opened for the human
